title: Nigeria Tax Act, 2025
version: as enacted, gazetted 26 June 2025 (Official Gazette No. 117, Vol. 112, Government Notice No. 26, pp. A385-A596); commencement 1 January 2026 (s. heading [1st January, 2026])
version_kind: gazetted text as enacted (no consolidation exists)
converter: gazette2txt.py (legalese commons, 2026-10-19): pdfplumber word positions; running heads dropped; paragraphs reflowed; marginal notes as [Marginal note: ...]; table rows as | a | b |; small-capital headings re-joined
text_caveat: Converted from the text layer of the gazette PDF. Marginal notes are placed before the paragraph beside which they start, which can put a note one paragraph late. Tables in the Schedules are rendered row by row from word positions; cells that wrap onto a second line are split across rows. The naira sign is printed as N in the source. Typos in the gazette (e.g. "ENECTED", "148--(1)" without a period) are kept.
why_this_instrument: Replaces the Personal Income Tax Act from 1 January 2026 (s. 195(g)): residence, employment income, chargeable income and eligible deductions (s. 30, including pension, NHF and NHIS contributions), the individual rates (Fourth Schedule), and exemptions including employment income of national minimum wage or less and pension funds (s. 162).
source_note: The file at https://tat.gov.ng/NIGERIA-TAX-ADMINISTRATION-ACT-2025.pdf contains the Nigeria Tax Act; the file named Nigeria-Tax-Act-2025.pdf on the same site contains the Nigeria Tax Administration Act. The two links on tat.gov.ng are crossed; this deposit is named by content.
